meta.title: Online Helper
meta.description: Opens Chrome with a debug port and keeps a course video playing, advancing to the next lesson and skipping exercises.

title: Online Helper
desc: Plays the course video and moves to the next lesson automatically when one finishes, skipping exercises. It opens a separate Chrome window with a debug port.
placeholder: Course video page URL, e.g. https://…/video/12345
no-events: Nothing yet. Press the button above to start.
started: Started. Chrome is opening the course page — log in there the first time.
no-browser: Chrome or Edge was not found, so the browser cannot be opened.
tip: First run: log in to the course platform in the Chrome window that opens. The session is kept in the dedicated profile.
persisted: State left by the previous run:
